create_qwen3_reward_model: create a Qwen3ForRewardModel instance with a Qwen2Config and optional quantization config for RLHF scoring
build_reward_model_score_head: build a 2-layer MLP scoring head with ReLU activation for single-label reward model output
run_reward_model_forward: run the Qwen3ForRewardModel forward pass on input_ids to produce pooled reward scores
load_reward_model_weights: load pretrained weights into Qwen3ForRewardModel skipping lm_head and rotary embedding parameters
configure_reward_model_pooler: configure a LAST pooling type pooler without normalization for reward model output
